part_text: Hi. whereas the ELA1a and the Commission1b warn that long and complex subcontracting chains are often misused to undermine accountability and workers’ rights; \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 1a ELA, Strategic Analysis, ‘Construction sector: Issues in information provision, enforcement of labour mobility law, social security coordination regulations, and cooperation between Member States’, 2023. 1b Commission report of 30 April 2024 on the application and implementation of the revised Posting of Workers Directive (COM(2024)0320).
